DIAGNOSIS READY: Metastatic Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Head and Neck to the Cervical Lymph Nodes.

The history of colon cancer is less relevant than the classic presentation of a painless, progressive neck mass in a 50-year-old male, which is highly suspicious for metastatic head and neck cancer. I will proceed with imaging to confirm this suspicion.
